setup: UPDATE posts SET like_count = id WHERE topic_id >= 34
UPDATE topics SET views = id * 10 WHERE id >= 34

INSERT INTO topic_voting_topic_vote_count (topic_id, votes_count, created_at, updated_at) SELECT id, id - 30, now(), now() FROM topics WHERE id >= 34 ON CONFLICT (topic_id) DO UPDATE SET votes_count = EXCLUDED.votes_count
UPDATE topic_users SET last_visited_at = NULL WHERE user_id = 3
